title: Window highlight shows the window title
goal: During a region capture the highlighted window is labelled with its app name and size. When an app has several windows open, adding the window title to that label tells you which one you are about to capture.
notes: kCGWindowName is only populated for apps with the Screen Recording grant, which the real app has and the probe does not. Add a title field to ScreenWindow, read it in WindowLister, extend WindowPick.label(for:). Depends on next-window-capture.
acceptance: The highlight label reads app, title and size when the window has a title, and app and size otherwise
Long titles are shortened so the pill stays inside the window or the display
Unit tests in PhotonzCore cover the label text and truncation

log.note: Pre-build review. Value is real only when an app has several similar windows (two browser windows, two editor windows); the label already names the app, so the title must be visually secondary or the pill turns into a wall of text over the very corner the eye uses to judge the outline. Decisions: app and size stay semibold white, the title sits between them in a lighter weight and slightly dimmer, separated by a middle dot; the title alone shortens (trailing ellipsis), never the app or the size; the pill is capped at 400 pt and never wider than the window it sits in (or the display when it hangs below a small window); titles that repeat the app name (Chromium-style 'Page - Microsoft Edge', or a window simply titled after its app) lose that repetition; a title that would shorten to under three characters is dropped rather than shown as a stub. No decision card: none of this changes what the feature does, only how the pill reads, and the audit asks the user to judge the look.

Cannot be verified live: kCGWindowName needs the Screen Recording grant, which neither this shell nor the probe bundle holds (checked: every on-screen window lists a nil name from here). Label text and shortening are unit tested in PhotonzCore; the probe run only confirms the title-less path still draws.

Built. PhotonzCore: ScreenWindow.title, WindowLabel (app / title / size, text), WindowPick.displayTitle (tidy, drop app-name repeats at either end), WindowPick.label(for:fitting:measure:) (bisects the title with a trailing ellipsis, drops it under 3 characters), WindowPick.fittedLabel (window room when the plain pill fits inside, else display room, cap 400 pt). 8 new tests in WindowPickTests, 17 total. App: WindowLister reads kCGWindowName; RectSelection draws the label in parts (app and size semibold white, title regular at 85% white, middle dot between) and fits it through the core with a real NSAttributedString measure. Flag description and docs/design/capture.md updated.

Verified on the real overlay: a temporary env-var harness in the probe injected four titled fake windows and snapshotted the view's own drawing (harness removed before commit). Results: 'Safari · Apple  640 × 300'; the Edge title cut to fit inside a 360 pt window with its '- Microsoft Edge' suffix gone; a 90 pt Finder window put the pill below itself, cut at the 400 pt cap; 'Calculator' titled 'Calculator' read app and size only. Two of those snapshots are in queue/audits as the audit's pictures. Full suite green (1205 tests) apart from the known ElementBounds timing flake, which passes alone.

Next: the region-capture highlight pill now reads app, window title and size (title lighter, cut to fit the window, the display, and a 400 pt cap; app-name repeats dropped). PhotonzCore WindowPick + WindowLabel, 8 new tests, 1205 green. Verified on the real overlay via a temporary probe harness; snapshots and audit in queue/audits/2026-09-02-window-highlight-title.json.
